hero.subtitulo: Experience thrilling 4x4 dune buggy rides and professional sandboarding against South America's most stunning sunset.

ventajas.seguridad_desc: Our dune buggies feature reinforced roll cages, and all drivers hold official MTC licenses.
ventajas.equipos_desc: Our boards come with foot bindings and special high-speed wax included.
ventajas.fotos_desc: Strategic stops at the highest dunes to capture the most breathtaking sunset photos.

faq.p1: What is the best time for the dune buggy tour?
faq.r1: The 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM slot is the most popular for experiencing the stunning sunset over the dunes.
faq.p2: Does the tour include the municipal tourist fee?
faq.r2: The dune entrance fee (S/ 3.70) is paid directly at the gate before boarding.
